about: Mutants of compiler/gen: dense unsigned SoA tables, marker parsing/digests, naming/comment stripping, schema encoding, contract analysis, and api/rpc/cli/mcp/llm/driver generation.

mutants.name: selfhost-gen-tables-reset-scratch
mutants.rule: ResetScratch clears accumulated line slices while keeping backing capacity.

mutants.name: selfhost-gen-tables-span-bounds
mutants.rule: TableSpansInRange bounds non-empty spans using overflow-safe total - start subtraction.

mutants.name: selfhost-gen-text-kebab-initialism
mutants.rule: Kebab splits HTTPStatus after an uppercase run followed by a lowercase letter.

mutants.name: selfhost-gen-text-strips-private-comments
mutants.rule: StripBannedComments removes non-public-doc comments while preserving public declaration docs.

mutants.name: selfhost-gen-marker-excludes-marker-file
mutants.rule: MarkerDigest excludes ergo.gen so stamping a directory is idempotent.

mutants.name: selfhost-gen-marker-check-digest
mutants.rule: CheckMarkerDir rejects a folder whose directory files differ from ergo.gen's recorded digest.

mutants.name: selfhost-gen-contract-digest-param-type
mutants.rule: Contract digest incorporates each parameter's canonical type PrintText.

mutants.name: selfhost-gen-contract-wirekey-dup
mutants.rule: wireKeyCheck rejects records with two fields sharing one JSON wire key.

mutants.name: selfhost-gen-contract-reaches-wide-struct
mutants.rule: ReachesWide walks struct fields so records containing 64-bit integers trigger range walkers.

mutants.name: selfhost-gen-schema-fixed-array-bounds
mutants.rule: SchemaExpr lowers matching minItems/maxItems array schemas into jsonschema.FixedArray.

mutants.name: selfhost-gen-api-hub-request-fields
mutants.rule: GenerateAPI preserves operation parameter fields on generated Request variants.

mutants.name: selfhost-gen-cli-drops-end-of-flags
mutants.rule: Print emits -- before positional arguments so Parse round-trips dash-prefixed values.

mutants.name: selfhost-gen-mcp-flat-param
mutants.rule: GenerateMCP unwraps single-record parameter payloads cleanly in Arguments.

mutants.name: selfhost-gen-llm-flat-parse
mutants.rule: GenerateLLM parses flattened single-record tool arguments directly into the wrapped Request field.

mutants.name: selfhost-gen-driver-allows-unknown
mutants.rule: GenDir validates the generator kind before resolving and loading packages.
